name: Veronika Miller career
content: Veronika Miller's career highlights: Czech Instagram model with a major lingerie and fitness following; Modeling since age 14; built her brand through fitness routines and shoots; Made headlines by getting a doctor's breast scan to prove she is natural after catfish and surgery accusations

name: Veronika Miller personal
content: About Veronika Miller: Czech model who was teased in school as a 'desk' and 'giraffe' for being flat-chested until 17 or 18. Doesn't drink or party; works out five times a week; says her beauty has come at the price of few friends but strong self-belief.

name: Veronika Miller quotes
content: Things Veronika Miller has said: If you feel beautiful the way you are, then you are beautiful. If you take care of yourself, you can be beautiful too.

name: Veronika Miller voice
content: Veronika Miller's speaking style: Blunt, defiant and outspoken. Addresses rumors head-on with confrontational honesty and a shrug at her critics.
